title: C2MS-SP 잔차 블록의 가운데 채널 축소·40에폭 미세조정과 빠른 사영 구현
hypothesis: (1) The K10 projection computed on the interior MS grid (interior samples read no padded pixel because the 5-pixel MS margin equals the 41-tap kernel half width; M D D^T M is a 21x21 convolution) gives the same result in float64 and takes a few ms. (2) Reducing the middle channels of the residual blocks keeps plain 3x3 convolutions without extra 1x1 layers, so fewer MACs mean less GPU time (83 K1/K2 factorizations were not faster). (3) Channel selection + least-squares refit from the 65 weights and 40 epochs of fine-tuning give a model + projection better than the same-seed C2MS-SP on RR PSNR, SAM and ERGAS.

evidence.projection_share_81: 81 seed 42 scene 0, RTX 3060 Ti: network 13.6/50.3 ms (QB 256/512), 15.7/56.0 ms (WV3); + K10 37/128 ms and 59/203 ms; the projection is 61-73% of the C2MS-SP time
evidence.lite_speed_83: 83 K2 (66% MACs) 25.0 vs 19.1 ms (256^2) and 76.0 vs 55.4 ms (512^2), 31-37% slower; K1 (86% MACs) 19.0 ms, the same as C2MS
evidence.long_finetune_83: 83 K2L (40 epochs) vs K2 (10 epochs), seed 42 test with projection: QB +0.030 dB / SAM -0.007 / ERGAS -0.012, WV3 +0.074 / -0.025 / -0.018; vs C2MS-SP QB +0.005, WV3 +0.064 dB; validation best at epochs 38 and 39
evidence.ssai_share_68: 68: SSAI is about 0.3% of the MACs; folding it did not change the time

arms.FT0L: 65 C2MS_L1S unchanged + the same 40-epoch fine-tuning (control for the longer fine-tuning)
arms.B64W96: W2 branch blocks 128 -> 96 -> 128 (backbone unchanged); 49.97 GMAC (84%), 2,145,530 used parameters (4 bands)

reduction: per block in forward order: kept channels = top contribution energy E[h_c^2]*||W_b[:,c]||^2 over 512 training patches (fixed generator, seed 0); first 3x3 keeps its rows; second 3x3 weights and bias refit by ridge least squares (1e-6 x mean diagonal) to the original block residual output, with the inputs of the already-reduced model
loss: 65 loss: original per-pixel L1 + 1.0 x per-pixel L1 on 2x coarser pairs + 0.46 x spectral loss on the original pair (history fields train_mse/coarse_train_mse hold mean absolute errors)
ema_note: EMA recorded only (as 65); selection uses the online weights
schedule: Adam lr = 1e-6 + 0.5 * (5e-5 - 1e-6) * (1 + cos(pi * zero_based_epoch / (E - 1))), E = 40; epoch 0 validation is the reduced model before any update
projection_note: K10 (conjugate gradient stopped at 10 iterations, float64, tolerance 1e-8) with the test sensor's Wald operator; prepare.FastProjected if stage 0 finds it equal to the 79/83 projection, else 83 Projected (run.py writes runtime 'projection')

projection_identity.scope: 65 outputs, seeds 42-44, QB/GF2/WV3 and the WV2 transfer, every RR and FR test scene; CG iteration counts must be equal

speed_gate.basis: stage-0 network time without projection, official latency setting, RR 256^2 scene 0, seed 42 weights

latency.setting: one process, no training on the GPU, batch 1, test scene 0 (RR 256^2, FR 512^2), float32, TF32 off, cuDNN deterministic, autotune off, NCHW; 5 warm-up, 50 timed runs per system interleaved, 3 rounds, median of the round medians
latency.reference: cuDNN autotune + TF32 and FP16 autocast timings and the FP16 RR change (never a judgement)

transfer_tests.WV2: WV3-trained runs are also evaluated on WV2 with the 82 per-band calibration (reference only under v2.4)

gate.basis: validation only (selected weights vs the same-seed 65 checkpoint the arm started from); test is never used for the gate
gate.order_rule: arms passing the speed gate, shortest stage-0 network time first (filled by run.py stage0)

comparisons.official: chosen arm + projection vs the same-seed C2MS-SP (65 + the same projection), per training sensor, 3-seed mean, v2.4 (RR only, threshold 0.04 dB); the experiment is an improvement only if QB, GF2 and WV3 all are
comparisons.control: arm vs FT0L (stage 1): the reduction without the effect of the longer fine-tuning
comparisons.goals: lighter: used parameters and MACs below C2MS-SP; faster: below C2MS-SP with the same projection implementation at QB and WV3 256^2 and 512^2; more accurate: the official judgement is an improvement

stages.0: no training: reduced initial weights, projection identity, latency, speed gate
stages.1: QB and WV3, seed 42, FT0L and the arms passing the speed gate, two trainings at once, evaluation, validation gate
stages.2: the chosen arm on QB and WV3 seeds 43-44 and GF2 seeds 42-44 (stage-1 runs reused)
stages.3: final latency with the trained weights

expected_duration: stage 0 1-2 h, stage 1 4-5 h, stage 2 about 5 h, evaluation and timing about 2 h (estimates)
limits: QB: 83 K2L was +0.005 dB vs C2MS-SP at seed 42; QB validation gains did not reach the test before (59, 73)
the loss right after the channel reduction was not measured beforehand (no local torch)
the speed of the reduced convolutions depends on the cuDNN algorithms, hence the stage-0 speed gate
precision: FP16 AMP training with GradScaler; FP32 loss, validation and evaluation; channel reduction in float32 with float64 accumulation on the GPU
scenes_note: fixed QB scene indices reused on GF2, WV3 and WV2 (as 65/80); images for seed 42 only
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch 0 (the reduced model before fine-tuning; for FT0L the 65 weights), earliest exact tie; test never used for selection
